description: Sub-2048-bit RSA keys generated through the other common key-generation APIs: node-rsa `new NodeRSA({ b: 512 })` for license signing, Web Crypto `crypto.subtle.generateKey` RSA-OAEP with modulusLength 1024 for end-to-end encryption, node-forge `pki.rsa.generateKeyPair({ bits: 1024 })` for a SAML signing certificate, python-rsa `rsa.newkeys(512)`, PHP `openssl_pkey_new(['private_key_bits' => 1024])` in a Laravel command, Ruby `OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(1024)` in a Rails initializer, Java `KeyPairGenerator.getInstance("RSA")` + `initialize(1024)` on the next line (and the same with the BouncyCastle provider, `getInstance("RSA", "BC")`), and Go `rsa.GenerateKey` written one argument per line. VC123 must fire on each.
